questions.question: I swim in the sea, click and whistle, and love to jump. Who am I?
questions.fact: Dolphins sleep with one half of their brain at a time!
questions.subject: Common bottlenose dolphin

questions.question: I have thick white fur and live on the Arctic ice. Who am I?
questions.fact: Under all that white fur, a polar bear's skin is black!
questions.subject: Polar bear

questions.question: I am the biggest animal that has ever lived. Who am I?
questions.fact: A blue whale's heart is as big as a bumper car!
questions.subject: Blue whale

questions.question: I open my tail like a giant colorful fan. Who am I?
questions.fact: Only the boys, called peacocks, have the big fancy tail!
questions.subject: Indian peafowl

questions.question: I have orange fur with black stripes. Who am I?
questions.fact: No two tigers have the same stripes!
questions.subject: Tiger

imageCredit.file: Bengal tiger (Panthera tigris tigris) female 3 crop.jpg
imageCredit.author: Charles J. Sharp

questions.question: I have a hard shell and lay my eggs on the beach. Who am I?
questions.fact: Sea turtles can hold their breath for hours while they sleep!
questions.subject: Green sea turtle

questions.question: I am small and spiky, and I curl up into a ball. Who am I?
questions.fact: A hedgehog has about 5,000 spikes called quills!
questions.subject: Hedgehog

questions.question: I have a long snout, lots of teeth, and bumpy skin. Who am I?
questions.fact: Crocodiles can't stick out their tongues!
questions.subject: Nile crocodile

final.title: Great guessing!
final.message: How many did you get right?
